route_title: Decoupled boundary-layer optimization with frozen central cavity
compilation_rationale: Compiled 16-layer alternating ZnSe/ZnS stack on Ge. Eight inner layers fixed, outer quadruplets optimized within ±40 nm. Spectrum covers both IR bands. Targets and objectives score average transmittance equally in longwave and midwave windows. Uncertainty applies absolute ±40 nm width.
